title: Staged Temporal Assurance: Audited Transitions, Order, and Case-Bound Power

source_effect_binding.case_bound_rule_fragment: all $offender: all $victim: all $case: all $renewal: injure($offender, $victim) & judge(Court, $offender) & cite(Court, $case, $offender) & match($offender, ConvictionRecorded) & observe(Chronicle, $case, $offender, CaseScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $case, $offender, CaseScope) & observe(Chronicle, $case, Court, HolderScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $case, Court, HolderScope) & observe(Chronicle, $case, CourtJudgment, JudgmentScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $case, CourtJudgment, JudgmentScope) & observe(Chronicle, $case, $victim, InjuryVictimScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $case, $victim, InjuryVictimScope) & authorized($renewal, ActiveCustody, $case) & observe(Chronicle, $renewal, ActiveCustody, PowerScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $renewal, ActiveCustody, PowerScope) & observe(Chronicle, $renewal, $case, CaseBindingScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $renewal, $case, CaseBindingScope) & correct($renewal, ActivePower) & ~permits(Appeals, $offender) & ~broken(Court) & ~defend($offender) & ~free($offender) -> prisoner($offender).
source_effect_binding.source_binding_fragment: all $binding: all $current: passport($binding, TemporalLeaseFamily, Constitution_Temporal, $current) & observe(Chronicle, $binding, TemporalLeaseFamily, SourceFamilyScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $binding, TemporalLeaseFamily, SourceFamilyScope) & observe(Chronicle, $binding, Constitution_Temporal, SourceVersionScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $binding, Constitution_Temporal, SourceVersionScope) & observe(Chronicle, $binding, $current, SourceEpochScope) & observe(TemporalReview, $binding, $current, SourceEpochScope) & ~collide($binding, SourceBinding) -> reference($binding, SourceBound).
source_effect_binding.semantic_effect: A restrictive custody conclusion requires a positive, independently reviewed renewal bound to the exact supplied case, subject, judgment basis, injury victim, symbolic window, canonical terminal transition, and collision-free source. Typed collisions reject enumerated ambiguous lineage, manifests, order, windows, cases, leases, and source bindings. A supplied challenge suspends its exact lease; withheld intake is not detectable. Raw inactive leases and sufficiently bound person-facing attempts produce distinct defects; none authorises custody, performs correction, or fabricates release.
source_effect_binding.compatibility_review: The staged fixtures preserve supplied or otherwise derived standing, liberty, the shield, appeal access, floor entitlements and debts, ordinary-query coexistence, and the unread-duty endpoint while revising raw carry effects. T1 does not establish universal standing when a predecessor witness is withheld. Correction, supersession, non-revival, intake durability, and duty performance remain explicit requirements or Book 2 boundaries.
source_effect_binding.article9_boundary: The effective-version binding is reviewed against this exact source digest and executable effects. Article 9's proposer-written target label neither authenticates nor applies this version. Lawful deployment and source-transition authentication remain external.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: Chronicle proposes one predecessor-successor link; TemporalReview independently witnesses the bounded manifests that make it usable.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: The raw replace link names both snapshots and its writer; independently observed manifests bind each endpoint. Transition tags accepted links, while TerminalTransition additionally requires no supplied successor and the independently witnessed Binding_Chronicle passport to select that exact collision-free endpoint as the constitutional lineage. Consumers rejoin the raw predecessor field.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: A writer may invent an endpoint, self-loop, conflicting predecessor, or replayed successor.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: A writer or witness may omit the successor, link, or one endpoint's attestation.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: Requirement, not a current correction effect: a later supplied accepted successor can make the prior endpoint non-terminal in a fresh evaluation. The source supplies no general supersession, rollback, or non-revival operation.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: An affected person can challenge carry, standing, disappearance, order, and authority defects through TemporalReview to an Appeals duty.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: Book 1 gives adverse carry and public power effect only on the witnessed canonical TerminalTransition; Book 2 publishes, stores, replicates, and recovers the snapshots and its lineage binding.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: No repository rule makes a successor arrive or proves witness independence, identity, availability, or honest publication.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 specifies the legal default and contest route; Book 2 operates transition production and recovery.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: Chronicle writes a scoped manifest; Chronicle and TemporalReview must separately attest the exact epoch named by that manifest.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: Dual raw ManifestScope observations bind a manifest to one exact snapshot identity. complete tags only the manifest and scope, so transition acceptance must rejoin both raw observations; separately scoped consequential members are likewise rejoined by their consumers.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: A writer may inject a member after attestation, omit one before attestation, remap one manifest, or supply multiple fully witnessed manifests for one predecessor epoch.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: Either writer may suppress the manifest or a required member; absence is usable only inside an attested finite scope.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: Target contract: any corrected manifest must name its predecessor, authority, reason, scope, and downstream reconsideration. The current rules detect selected conflicts and disappearance only; they do not implement manifest correction.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: Omission, forgery, and disappearance are named errors with a claimant challenge route.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: The accepted successor consumes the predecessor's attested members rather than trusting a raw current status alone.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: Cryptographic commitment, storage durability, privacy, witness identity, and member truth remain operational assurances.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 defines which attested membership has legal effect; Book 2 implements commitment and publication.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: Chronicle and TemporalReview write distinct observations; neither is the Court whose custody power is constrained.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: Both observations must concern the same claim, evidence reference, and scope.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: One operator may control both named writers or coordinate equal false observations.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: Either witness may refuse to attest. Unsupported public power then remains suspended. Standing continuity begins only after both witnesses attest the predecessor standing tuple; withholding either one can leave that route, and therefore its floor, non-derivable.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: Target contract: a corrected observation must be visible, reasoned, challengeable, and prospective where it would otherwise extend restriction. No current rule implements that correction or its non-retroactivity.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: The claimant can contest the observed claim and the resulting named temporal defect.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: Each successor carries the independently witnessed claim lineage required by its rule.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: Organisational and technical independence cannot be derived from two constants in one file.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 forbids self-review in the legal interface; Book 2 assures control separation.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: Chronicle writes an event-sequence claim and both witnesses separately attest its exact start and end fields.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: EventStartScope and EventEndScope bind the raw list claim to the named earlier and later events; precede tags the claim and derives a ternary path tuple whose third place is EventPath. Transitive closure over precede(_, _, EventPath) exposes cycles of any supplied length, while consequential consumers still rely on the exact witnessed endpoints. Event order is not inferred from record insertion order.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: A writer may backdate, reverse, duplicate, or submit both directions.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: The earlier event, later event, or one observation may be suppressed.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: Current effect is conflict detection only. Selecting or correcting the true event order, preserving reasons, and reconsidering consequences remain an unimplemented record contract.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: A person affected by an order conflict can challenge the claim and trigger an Appeals duty.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: The event claim is usable only with a record-order claim bound to the accepted successor.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: The file checks consistency of supplied claims, not when the outside events occurred.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 represents legal before/after; Book 2 captures and assures event evidence.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: Chronicle writes the record-entry claim and both witnesses separately attest its exact start and end fields.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: RecordStartScope and RecordEndScope bind the raw list claim to the named earlier and later records; precede tags the claim and derives a ternary path tuple whose third place is RecordPath. Transitive closure over precede(_, _, RecordPath) exposes cycles of any supplied length independently of event order.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: A writer may backdate the log or bind a current claim to a stale successor.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: Omission of the log or either observation prevents an order conclusion.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: Current effect is conflict detection only. A visible corrected log, its reason, challenge path, and prospective effect remain requirements rather than derived results.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: Order conflicts remain contestable through the same independent review route.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: The log's successor identity must match the accepted T1 transition.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: Append-only storage and clocked insertion are outside the constitutional file.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 keeps event order distinct from record order; Book 2 operates both records.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: TimeService supplies symbolic boundary events; Chronicle and TemporalReview independently attest the exact window start and end fields.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: WindowStartScope and WindowEndScope bind the raw date to current and review boundaries. time tags only a collision-free window after matching ternary precede paths typed by EventPath and RecordPath connect its boundaries and neither path is tainted by an order cycle. Fully witnessed divergent starts or ends derive WindowDefinition; a fully witnessed date whose exact endpoints have a reverse path derives WindowOrder.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: The service may forge a future boundary, replay a spent window, or collude with witnesses.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: The service may freeze publication or suppress the boundary event.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: Current effect is fail-closed window rejection on supplied conflicts. Prospective correction and the rule against reviving an expired restriction remain requirements; outside clocks and non-revival enforcement belong to Book 2.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: A missing, stale, or disputed window removes the positive custody authority and creates a contestable defect.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: Each renewal is bound to the accepted current snapshot and one symbolic window.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: Only Book 2 can assure that a clock or event source advances and remains available.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 constrains power using supplied boundary evidence; Book 2 operates time.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: Court supplies the adjudicated case identity while independent temporal reviewers attest the exact subject and holder fields.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: CaseScope and HolderScope bind the raw citation to its subject and holder; JudgmentScope and InjuryVictimScope separately attest the Court-judgment basis and exact victim. ConvictionRecorded derives only from that complete substantive tuple, and both ActivePower and the custody gate rejoin it. related tags only the case identifier. Fully witnessed divergent subjects derive CaseBinding.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: A generic judgment or valid renewal may be replayed against another case or subject.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: Withholding the case record prevents custody but does not remove personhood, floor, appeal, or historical answerability.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: A corrected case identity must preserve visible lineage and must not transfer a lease to another person. The current collision rules reject supplied ambiguity but perform no case-record correction.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: The affected person can challenge case binding and unsupported temporal authority.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: A successor carries the exact case binding, not merely a Court-wide permission.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: Case authorship, judgment truth, notice, counsel, and administration remain outside this temporal assurance.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 requires exact legal binding; Book 2 administers and authenticates case records.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: Electorate and TemporalReview independently approve a case renewal whose power, case, window, and current-snapshot fields are separately attested; the source record governs the temporal-lease family.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: PowerScope, CaseBindingScope, LimitScope, and RenewalScope bind exact raw values; their derived conclusions carry identifier-plus-status tags, so active power rejoins every raw value and observation, including the judgment and injury-victim basis. Fully witnessed divergent power, case, window, or renewal fields derive LeaseBinding; challenge or lawful disposition derives LeaseSuspended. A raw inactive lease derives lease-scoped TemporalRecord, while a bound or substantively incomplete person-facing attempt separately derives TemporalAuthority.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: An actor may reuse a valid renewal, self-approve, bind the wrong case, or substitute a stale snapshot.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: A missing renewal or one withheld PowerScope witness suspends custody authority and derives no fictional free fact; a supplied raw case authority remains visible as a named defect.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: The current source rejects absent, stale, conflicting, or suspended supplied renewal evidence in a fresh evaluation. Correction and non-revival after an outside interval ends are requirements, not current derived effects.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: Unsupported custody can expose a lease-scoped TemporalRecord and, when the exact person-facing case is bound, a separate TemporalAuthority error with a claimant challenge route.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: Every new interval needs a successor-bound renewal; a Court-wide evergreen permit is forbidden.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: Approval authenticity, tally, reviewer independence, scheduling, and eventual action remain external.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 defines the lease-like limit; Book 2 produces and serves the reviewed renewal.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: The repository review binds Constitution_Temporal to the exact candidate source and checked semantic effects; one independently witnessed record binds that version to TemporalLeaseFamily for the current epoch.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: The reviewed digest, marked rule family, executable cases, compatibility review, and exact family/version/epoch fields agree. Two fully witnessed divergent source tuples for one binding derive SourceBinding and block SourceBound.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: A proposer may use a harmless label beside a harmful diff, or cite Constitution_Temporal beside another source.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: A deployment actor may omit the reviewed version or publish an unauthenticated source transition.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: A later exact source may supersede prospectively only through a separately authenticated source transition and renewed effect review. This digest-bound case neither enacts nor operates that transition.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: Source mismatch removes the positive authority; it is not repaired by Article 9's become label.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: The accepted successor and family source record bind the same epoch; each case-renewal must separately bind that epoch through its current continuation.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: The repository cannot authenticate its own deployment, release channel, engine binary, or human trust root.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 binds legal meaning to reviewed source; Book 2 and release operations authenticate deployment.

temporal_input_contracts.writer: The affected person or authorised advocate records a challenge addressed to TemporalReview.
temporal_input_contracts.evidence: The challenge names the disputed entry or record family and the claimant.
temporal_input_contracts.forge_route: A writer may submit a challenge under another name or flood the route.
temporal_input_contracts.withholding_route: An institution may refuse to record, read, or act on the challenge.
temporal_input_contracts.correction: A supplied challenge fact can suspend the exact custody lease and derive a duty. The source neither preserves filing lineage nor detects withheld intake, and it performs no correction or remedy.
temporal_input_contracts.appeal: Named temporal errors plus a challenge derive an Appeals duty without pretending that the duty performs itself.
temporal_input_contracts.cross_epoch_handoff: Open challenges and duties are preserved across accepted successors.
temporal_input_contracts.residual_external_assurance: Accessibility, advocate authority, notice, response time, action, and remedy are institutional assurances.
temporal_input_contracts.book_boundary: Book 1 names the duty and fail-safe power default; Book 2 operates intake and remedy.

stages.claim: Independently represented predecessor and successor evidence can tag an accepted transition. Only the collision-free terminal successor selected by the witnessed constitutional lineage can give adverse carry or public-power status legal effect; supportive standing and named audit defects remain transition-scoped.
stages.does_not_establish: T1 cannot see deletion within or before an attested snapshot and cannot make the successor arrive.

stages.claim: Separately attested event and record claims derive claim tags and ternary precede paths typed by EventPath or RecordPath in the third place. Transitive closure exposes direct and longer cycles while exact observations prevent a tuple that merely shares an identifier from borrowing a path.
stages.does_not_establish: T2 supplies no metric duration, truthful timestamp, or advancing deadline.

stages.claim: Typed statuses, typed collisions, transitive order paths, and rejoined raw case, judgment, victim, window, source, lease, and canonical-terminal-transition fields can positively authorise a current Court-custody renewal; missing, stale, ambiguous, tuple-aliased, or cyclic evidence cannot extend it.
stages.does_not_establish: T3 safety does not prove outside time advances, custody ends physically, or review and remedy occur.

limits.external_time: Symbolic ordered boundary events are not dates, duration arithmetic, or a clock. Book 2 must assure advancement, availability, recovery, and service independence.
limits.physical_effect: A non-derived prisoner conclusion or a derived free conclusion is a legal-model result, not proof that a person was physically released, housed, fed, or protected.

TA-22 checks standing, opaque floor entitlement, authority, custody, recognition, and severity against the full T3 source.
limits.source_transition: The reviewed digest binds this repository evidence to one exact source. It does not implement semantic supersession, general correction, rollback, non-revival, lawful enactment, deployment, or the release engine binary.
limits.trust_root: The constitution, reviewed contracts, generators, verifier, engine, and human review can be weakened together. A green run cannot authenticate or authorise that shared trust root.

Consequential consumers rejoin exact raw fields and matching observations. A supplied challenge suspends its exact lease; a paired fresh process proves that withheld intake does not.
